About the Pedal & Pour Sunday Coffee Ride group ride

A coffee shop and bike shop in one. The Sunday Coffee Ride is a relaxed 20-mile loop from the shop that ends back at the cafe. Friday's Loop Ride is 41 miles for more experienced riders. RSVP through the shop's Strava club.
